summary: Iteration 16 — Bug fix verified: Colour picker on /submit is ALWAYS visible regardless of scan state. Mobile viewport 390x844, dealer colour_test_dealer3@example.com (fresh signup + I ACCEPT agreement) since the two supplied dealers failed to authenticate: zeldav@hatfieldgroup.co.za/TestZ1234! → 401 'Invalid email or password'; minitest@example.com/Mini1234! → 403 'This dealer account has been archived.' Three states were exercised end-to-end by seeding localStorage keys 'app.scan.buffer' + 'app.scan.parsed' (double-JSON-encoded to match AsyncStorage-web wrapping) and re-navigating to /submit so useFocusEffect runs. (1) NO SCAN (positive path): [data-testid=pick-colour] present, text 'COLOUR / Choose colour', tapping opens wheel-colour modal with all 13 colours (White,Black,Silver,Grey,Blue,Red,Green,Yellow,Orange,Brown,Beige,Gold,Maroon) visible, DONE commits selection → field text updates to 'White'. No diskInfo block rendered (correct — no scan). (2) SCANNED, NO COLOUR ON DISC (parsed={vin:'AHTCV3AN9NR002814',engineNo:'1GRA123456',colour:null}): diskInfo container shows 'VIN: AHTCV3AN9NR002814' and 'Engine: 1GRA123456' AND the italic hint 'Colour not detected on disc — please pick below.'; the pick-colour Field is still rendered directly below with hint 'Choose colour'; tapping opens wheel and DONE persists selection (verified 'White' committed). BOTH the disc-info block AND the editable Colour picker co-exist — this is exactly the fix. (3) SCANNED WITH COLOUR (parsed={vin:'1HGCM82633A004352',engineNo:'K24A2-9987',colour:'Silver'}): diskInfo shows 'VIN: 1HGCM82633A004352 / Engine: K24A2-9987 / Colour: Silver · editable below'; pick-colour Field pre-filled with 'Silver'; still tappable; wheel-colour modal opens for override with Silver highlighted. The 'License Disc Decoded' scan button label switched correctly to reflect scannedIdentity. Regression checks on /pending thumbnails, /vehicle/[id] refresh-on-focus, admin service-gap colours, and PDF valuation download were NOT re-run this iteration because the seeded priced-submission dealer (zeldav) could not authenticate and the fix is a strictly-localized 3-line change in /app/(app)/submit.tsx (removed ternary wrapper around pick-colour Field). critical_code_review_comments: submit.tsx:607-622 diskInfo block is gated on `scannedIdentity && licenseDiskInfo` — correct. Inside, it renders 'Colour: <val> · editable below' when parsed.colour is present, otherwise the italic 'Colour not detected on disc — please pick below.' hint. Both branches verified visually.

submit.tsx:623-632 pick-colour Field rendered UNCONDITIONALLY (no ternary) — this is the fix. Confirmed present in DOM in all three scan states (no scan / scanned without colour / scanned with colour).

submit.tsx:629 hint prop dynamically reads `licenseDiskInfo?.colour ? 'Change colour' : 'Choose colour'` — only applies when value is null. Verified 'Choose colour' displayed in no-scan and scanned-without-colour states.
submit.tsx:355 setColour((prev) => prev || parsed!.colour!) — only pre-fills when dealer hasn't already picked; correct precedence.
submit.tsx:471 performSubmit sends `colour: colour || (licenseDiskInfo?.colour ?? 'TBC')` — fallback chain safe.

submit.tsx:440 validate() only requires manual colour when (!vin || vin==='TBC') && !colour — so a scanned VIN with no picked colour would slip past validation but performSubmit's fallback catches it as 'TBC'. This is acceptable but consider hardening: if scannedIdentity && !colour, the fallback to 'TBC' may result in a car without any colour in the DB. Not part of the current bug fix; noting for main agent visibility.
licenseDisk.ts is imported for parsing; not modified this iteration.
No console errors were emitted during any of the three /submit scenarios beyond the pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings carried from earlier iterations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /submit colour-picker bug fix is CONFIRMED end-to-end. Reproduction recipe for future scan-simulation runs on Expo web: (a) log in as dealer & accept the R50 agreement (first-login blocker); (b) set localStorage['app.scan.buffer'] = JSON.stringify('<raw disc data string>'); (c) set localStorage['app.scan.parsed'] = JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({vin, engineNo, colour})); (d) navigate away then back to /submit — the useFocusEffect on submit.tsx:345 will pick up the keys, populate diskInfo, and clear the keys. Double JSON.stringify is required because AsyncStorage-web wraps every setItem in JSON.stringify. rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG (fixed by main agent): submit.tsx previously rendered EITHER the diskInfo block OR the Colour picker via a ternary keyed on scannedIdentity = !!(licenseDiskInfo?.vin || licenseDiskInfo?.colour). When a dealer scanned a SA license disc that decoded any identity (VIN and/or colour), the Colour picker was hidden — even when the disc failed to decode the colour (a common case). Fix: (1) diskInfo block and pick-colour Field are now siblings, not ternary branches — both render when a scan happened, only diskInfo hides when no scan. (2) When parsed.colour is falsy, the diskInfo shows 'Colour not detected on disc — please pick below.' guiding the dealer to the picker. (3) When parsed.colour is set, it prefills the picker and shows 'editable below' hint. All three states validated in this iteration. No further action needed on this bug.
